import re


def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace all non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    # Remove leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip("-")
    return text


def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + "..."
